_doc: Regression test set for the DealWave agent. Each case asserts the agent's autonomous tool-selection behavior and the synthesized verdict's shape and value ranges. Run with `pnpm eval`. Production extension: wire to CI to fail builds on regression.

cases.description: Property with a severity-5 valuation flag. Agent should auto-chain pull_comps based on system-prompt signals (confidenceScore < 60, severity-4+ flag mentioning valuation).
cases.input: Analyze 10165 W Burntwood Ct, Boise, ID

cases.description: High-score property (dealScore typically 91, Grade A). Verdict may be strong-deal / good-deal / investigate depending on how Sonnet weighs the severity-5 valuation spread against the high score. All three are reasonable.
cases.input: Analyze 3861 S Baja Way, Boise, ID

cases.description: Conceptual question — agent should NOT call analysis tools. Catches regressions where a prompt change makes the agent over-eager to invoke tools.
cases.input: What does ARV stand for in real estate investing?
